summary: Frontend-only verification of the new 'checking_stock' pre-flight step in the Create Production Order progress panel (ProductionConfirmationPage.js). Used a synthetic vms_session cookie (tests/_setup_pc_session.py) and page.route mocks for POST /api/production-confirmation/create-and-release-order (job_id=mock-job-1) and its status endpoint - no real SAP call/order was created. All requested checks PASSED: 5-step order running -> checking_stock -> creating_proposal -> waiting_for_order -> releasing_order with checking_stock as step 2 titled 'Checking live component stock in SAP (~45s)'; step 1 shows green checkmark, step 2 active (animate-pulse, orange) with badge '2', steps 3-5 greyed/pending; submit button label becomes 'Checking live SAP stock for all components... (6s)' with an incrementing counter. Elapsed counter ticked exactly 1s per second across 8 samples [6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13] (no 4s jumps). Failure path: mocked status 'failed' with the insufficient-stock error rendered the exact message in a toast and fully reset the form (button back to 'Create Production Order', enabled, progress panel unmounted - not stuck spinning). Light regressions clean: Product ID typeahead + SoS picker resolved 2 Production Models for BK-0021, Site auto-locked to P2, UoM locked from SAP base unit, Production Confirmation open-lots list loaded 113 reporting points / 100 lots instantly with Stock badges (OK / 'No BOM cached'). Zero console errors in both runs.

issues: Cosmetic only, no action strictly needed: for the first ~4s (until the first 4s poll returns) the button reads 'Starting... (Ns)' and step 1 is active, so the user briefly does not see the new stock-check step. Could optimistically set phase to 'checking_stock' immediately or do a first poll after ~1s.

critical_code_review_comments: STEP_ORDER/STEP_TITLES/PHASE_LABELS are consistent with the backend job statuses ('checking_stock' set before check_component_availability) - verified by reading backend/server.py job flow references; no mismatch found.
ProductionConfirmationPage.js is ~1120 lines - consider splitting CreateOrderTab / ConfirmDialog into separate modules (>700 line guideline).

Delete the auth_users/auth_sessions docs for user_id '2a94b71e-...:TEST-QA-OID' when done. Progress-step state can be asserted via inner_html of [data-testid=create-proposal-step-<phase>] ('bg-[#027A48]' = done, 'animate-pulse' = active).
